business_problem: THE CHALLENGE How to manage and scale with an overgrowing amount of dynamic data Omnichat was consistently adding new marketing features to its omnichannel messaging solution, generating large amounts of data.
solution_summary: THE CHALLENGE How to manage and scale with an overgrowing amount of dynamic data Omnichat was consistently adding new marketing features to its omnichannel messaging solution, generating large amounts of data. MongoDB Atlas makes it easy to evolve, avoid downtime and enable native full-text search within the same data platform Omnichat Talk to an Expert MongoDB Atlas empowers Omnichat deliver Omnichannel chat commerce solutions to its 5,000 merchants Industry Marketing Automation Product MongoDB Atlas Use Case Personalisation Content Management Customer since 2019 INTRODUCTION With teams in Hong Kong SAR, Taiwan, Singapore and Malaysia, is a leading omnichannel chat retail commerce solution provider across Asia Pacific.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational data and provides the managed document database foundation for Omnichat's workload.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Provides integrated full-text and faceted search across Omnichat's application data.

data_flow: Operational events and application data flow into MongoDB Atlas, where the platform stores current state and supports real-time queries for downstream applications and integrations such as WhatsApp.
business_outcome: Leveraging data with MongoDB Atlas supports complex marketing automation to increase conversion
metrics: Their relational database was unsuited for the large volume of unstructured data they needed to manage, which included 400 million chat records.
With around 34 million customer profile documents, 1.6 billion documents quarterly and 400 million message documents, scalability was another issue with their relational database.
Omnichat currently uses Atlas Search on 3 native clusters for customer profile, message, and customer behaviour events data.

By using Omnichat’s Omnichannel Chat Commerce Solutions – which includes sending automated messages via WhatsApp to remind customers of unchecked items in abandoned shopping carts – FILA increased its conversion rate for completed transactions by 3.5 times.
architecture_clues: Sharding is used to scale data horizontally.
Full-text or faceted search runs inside the MongoDB platform.
APIs are a key integration layer in the application architecture.
